form.workshopDescription: Workshops provide an excellent opportunity to showcase your company's expertise, share knowledge with students and professionals, and engage directly with potential candidates. If you plan to conduct a workshop during the fair, please indicate this below and we will contact you to arrange details. The number of available spots is limited.

form.jobwallDescription: We encourage you to post job positions on our Jobwall, which will be physically present during the event and also on the job fair website. This is an excellent opportunity to reach qualified candidates directly during the event. You can add multiple job positions, each with detailed information including position name, work form, workload, contract type, description, benefits, requirements, and application details. Please note that each job position posting has an additional cost.
form.catalogueDescription: The catalog (paper version) and e-catalog (on the job fair website) is a list of all exhibitors of the Engineering Job Fair. Take care of your company's visibility and submit an engaging company description and logo.
form.electricDevicesDescription: Please provide information about the electric devices you will use during the fair. This information is needed to calculate the power paths and ensure proper electrical distribution. Specify the devices you plan to use and their total power consumption.
form.lunchesDescription: You can order lunches for your team during the fair. Lunches will be provided by Bistro Chochelka. Please specify the day, quantity, and any dietary requirements or restrictions for each lunch order. You can add multiple lunch orders for different days or with different dietary requirements.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to frequently asked questions about the Engineering Job Fair.

location.question: Where is the fair taking place?
location.answer: The Engineering Job Fair is taking place at the Main Building of Warsaw University of Technology at Plac Politechniki 1, Warsaw.

dates.question: When is the fair taking place?
dates.answer: The fair takes place on March 10-11, 2026. The fair starts at 9:00 AM and ends at 4:00 PM on both days. The official opening is on March 10 at 10:00 AM.

wifi.question: What is the Wi-Fi password?
wifi.answer: The Wi-Fi password will be provided to exhibitors on the fair day by their assigned supervisor.

unloading.question: Where can I unload materials?
unloading.answer: For unloading your vehicle, a short stop (5 min) is possible at the Main Building from Noakowskiego Street. Entry to the Square is from Stanisława Noakowskiego Street.

parking.question: Do you provide parking spaces?
parking.answer: We do not provide parking spaces. Paid parking lots are available near the Main Building of Warsaw University of Technology.

parkingPrices.question: What are the parking prices in the area?
parkingPrices.answer:
1. City Paid Parking (with parking meters):
   - First hour: 4.50 PLN
   - Second hour: 5.40 PLN
   - Third hour: 6.40 PLN
   - Each additional hour: 4.50 PLN

2. CPG Underground Guarded Parking at Progi 1:
   - Price per hour: 6 PLN
   - Price per day: 50 PLN

3. Hala Koszyki Evend Parking, Koszykowa 63:
   - First hour: 10 PLN
   - Each additional started hour: 10 PLN

4. Interparking Piękna 20:
   - Price per hour: 7 PLN
   - With online reservation: 50 PLN per day

setupTime.question: When can I set up promotional materials?
setupTime.answer: On the fair day, it is possible to arrive from 6:30 AM to set up promotional materials (roll-ups, walls, posters, gadgets).

ownSetup.question: When can I set up my own construction?
ownSetup.answer: Exhibitors who have their own construction and are exhibiting on the first day can set it up on March 10. Exhibitors who are only exhibiting on the second day can set up their construction on March 11. The speciic timeslots will be consulted with assigned supervisor.

wallRestrictions.question: Can I stick materials on the construction walls?
wallRestrictions.answer: Printed materials cannot be stuck on construction walls – this leads to wall damage. In case of wall damage resulting from sticking promotional materials on it, the company will incur an additional cost.

supervisor.question: Will I have an assigned supervisor?
supervisor.answer: Yes, during the event you will have an assigned company supervisor from the organizers. This person will be at your disposal for questions or comments regarding the course of the Engineering Job Fair. Please save the contact information of your assigned supervisor and contact them in case of problems.

lunch.question: Is lunch included in the package?
lunch.answer: Yes, as part of the package, two of your delegates are provided with a lunch in the form of a hot meal (2 lunches per company per day, additional can be bought in the formular or during the fairs through your supervisor). The welcome package will contain vouchers that can be exchanged for lunch at the Central Canteen of Warsaw University of Technology "Bistro Chochelka" (Rektorska 2). The scheduled lunch hours are: 12:00-15:00.

coffee.question: Will there be a coffee point available?
coffee.answer: Yes, during the fair there will be a coffee point available with coffee and sweet treats.

gala.question: When is the Employer for Engineer Gala taking place?
gala.answer: This year's gala presenting the results of the Employer for Engineer survey will take place on March 10 in the Small Hall of the Main Building of Warsaw University of Technology. During the gala, the results of the study on the expectations of students and graduates of technical universities regarding the job market will be presented.
